name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that overlays the dark theme’s text and background in real time. This forces every text element to meet WCAG AA standards before it ever reaches the user, cutting off the biggest source of readability complaints. The trade-off is a small performance hit from constant color sampling, but it’s worth it—users won’t tolerate unreadable text, and fixing it later is far costlier.

name: Pane
text: The live contrast checker trains users to ignore the problem—once they see the contrast "pass" in real time, they’ll assume it’s fixed forever, even if later edits break it. A better alternative is a pre-submission block that fails the build if contrast drops below WCAG AA, forcing the team to address it before shipping. Settle this by testing both: measure user drop-off with the blocker versus false confidence with the live checker over two sprints.
